payload.name: ExtractExplicitObjectIdentification
payload.description: When a speaker explicitly identifies what an object, picture, map, or other item is, create a memory candidate capturing that item and its explicit description.
content: During extraction, if a message explicitly states what an object or visual is (phrases like 'It's a map of...' or 'This is a photo of...'), generate a candidate memory for that item and its stated subject/content.
Do not skip such statements because the message also contains enthusiasm or background detail; preserve the factual identification in a compact memory tied to the speaker and context.

solves: Construction extraction sometimes omits factual statements that explicitly identify an object or visual because the same message also contains subjective reactions or background detail. This skill applies to future sessions whenever a speaker states what a shown item is, ensuring the item's explicit subject or content is captured as a memory instead of being dropped.
